provenance.character_rules: Rounded white LEVEL pill/arc eyes + tiny simple mouth on black; no pupils/bodies/human lips/slanted almond eyes.

pairings.summary: Anticipatory eye-squeeze, closed-arc sneeze with O mouth, bold pop-open recovery.

ffmpeg_ebur128_app_copy.limitation: Integrated LUFS is unreliable for very short (<1s) isolated beeps; use sample_peak_dbfs and active_rms_dbfs for relative matching. No phone / device audition performed.

limits_and_method.primary_matching: Sample peak ceiling ~-6.5 dBFS; active-region RMS nudged toward ~-17.5 dBFS (family ballpark from read-only metrics on already-approved short beeps wink/giggle at ~-7.54 peak / ~-17.8 active-ish RMS on 22.05 kHz drafts — those files were not rewritten).
limits_and_method.ffmpeg_ebur128: Also reported per file via ffmpeg ebur128=peak=true. Integrated LUFS for sub-1s beeps is imperfect / unstable; do not treat as universal loudness equivalence. Prefer sample_peak_dbfs + active_rms_dbfs.
limits_and_method.limitations: No listening test on phone speakers. Global app mix balance owned elsewhere. Short clips make I-LUFS a weak comparator.
limits_and_method.note_astats_removed: ffmpeg astats fields previously stored last-window values and conflicted with full-signal numpy/ebur128 metrics; removed as unusable for whole-clip reporting.
